correction: Rule C needs a matching glob for each required path, not 1 match in total; a level is checked for its exact value inside jq, because a command substitution strips a trailing LF; and a glob segment pattern must not return through a command substitution for the same reason.

A check that a ruleset requires must run on every PR type of the repository, including the GITHUB_TOKEN bot PR, which starts no pull_request workflow; so check-dependencies.yml dispatches ci.yml as well as build.yml.

correction: The level of a path is the strictest level of its matching globs, and default_level applies only when no glob matches, so the default is not a floor (core risk-paths spec rule D).

A command whose output a check reads must run in the parent shell with its exit status checked: inside a process substitution the status is lost, so 1 failed objdump or find left the check passing on the sonames of the other files; an od header read that fails must fail the check too, not skip the file as not ELF.
